name: a-portrait
prompt: Use <image1> as the exact character reference for Momo: preserve the same warm apricot tadpole body, cream belly stripe, coral three-lobed gill fronds on both sides, dark teal eyes, cheeks, friendly face and flat contour-free shape language. Create a polished 1024 by 1024 mobile app icon for a German health and weight-loss app for two partners named Gemeinsam leichter. Full-bleed square artwork with all important content safely inside the central 70 percent for iOS and Android masks. No words, no letters, no numbers, no logo mockup, no device, no transparency, no already-rounded app-icon frame, no thin outlines, no gradients, no shadows, no texture. Flat clean vector-like shapes. Adult-friendly and warm, playful only in detail. Exact palette: sand #FBF4E6, deep lagoon teal #0B7470, self teal #0E8580, partner orange #C9662B, gold #F2B33D, ink #1D3332, Momo apricot #FFC56E, cream #FFEBC4, coral #F48C73. Composition: a large close-up portrait of smiling Momo centered and immediately recognizable at tiny size. Behind Momo, two bold broad organic semicircles, one lagoon teal and one partner orange, meet and gently overlap to express two people supporting one another. Sand fills the remaining corners. Use only a few large shapes and strong silhouette. Momo is the focus; no extra symbols.
